company.name: bellboy
company.shortDescription: Ai powered SaaS product for vacation rentals and boutique hotels to streamline and automate the entire guest experience
company.description: Bellboy is a SaaS company founded in 2024 that provides AI-driven solutions for the hospitality and short-term rental industry. It offers intelligent voice and messaging agents designed to handle guest interactions such as reservations, inquiries, room service requests, and support—around the clock. The platform acts as a virtual “AI employee” for hotels and vacation rentals, capable of managing bookings, answering guest queries instantly, and automating repetitive front-desk tasks. Its multilingual capabilities and real-time responses help improve guest experience while reducing staff workload and operational costs.
